card.name: Just before an age range is given
card.fires_on: The word or bracket right after a group like adults or young adults, where an age range (such as ages 18 to 24) is about to follow. Seen in antidepressant suicidality warnings.

modes.label: Opening bracket after young adults
modes.description: The open parenthesis after 'young adults' that leads into 'ages 18 to 24'.
modes.example: in children, adolescents, and young adults<< (>>ages 18 to 24

modes.label: Preposition or group word before age
modes.description: The word 'in' or 'adults' just before a statement about age limits or adult patients.
modes.example: compared with placebo in<< adults>> beyond age 24; there was

card.writes: It suppresses the word age and its variants, so the next word is probably not 'age' itself.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to state an age range for a patient group, as in warnings about young adults.
